title: Edition
description: A concrete text of a Work: a source recension, a translation, or a transliteration.

script.description: ISO 15924, e.g. Deva, Arab, Hebr, Hans.

authority.description: How the tradition regards this edition. Qur'an translations MUST be 'interpretive-of-meaning' and are labelled as such in the UI — this is the tradition's own position, not a courtesy. See docs/03-corpus.md.

immutable.description: True for sacred source texts. The loader refuses any transform, including normalisation for search, on the stored form.

normalization.description: Span offsets are measured against text in this form.

divine_name_policy.description: How the Tetragrammaton or equivalent is rendered in this edition. Declared, never silently normalised.

jurisdiction_notes.description: Public domain is jurisdictional. The KJV remains under Crown letters patent in the UK; a 14th-c. tafsir is PD but a modern translation OF it is a fresh copyrightable work.
